function: Channel synthesis: a conditional diffusion model (cDDIM) generates user-position-conditioned MIMO channels to augment scarce data for downstream CSI compression and beam alignment (p. 3).
system: Narrowband MIMO, no RIS, 28 GHz: QuaDRiGa with 32-antenna ULA BS and 4-antenna UE; DeepMIMO with 4x4 UPA BS and 2x2 UPA UE (pp. 3, 8, 9).
method: Conditional DDIM (U-net, 62k parameters) trained by supervised denoising score matching on beamspace channels; CRNet and beam-alignment MLP then trained on augmented data (pp. 5, 7, 11).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa Berlin UMa LOS for CSI compression (0.5K-10K training pairs, 10,000 test); DeepMIMO Outdoor 1 blockage for beam alignment (100 training, 80,000 test) (pp. 8, 9, 11, 13).
test_conditions: Exp ID: train and test within 100 m; Exp OOD: train within 100 m, test on 100-200 m donut; downstream tasks use separate test channels (pp. 7, 11, 13).
baselines: Gaussian-noise augmentation, ChannelGAN, cGAN, one-shot U-net, no-DFT and unconditioned cDDIM, closest training sample; beam selection: MRC+MRT, DFT+EGC, Genie DFT, exhaustive search (pp. 9, 10, 12).
metrics: CDF of peak beam-index difference, NMSE of CRNet CSI reconstruction, average SNR of synthesized beams vs number of probing beams (pp. 10, 11, 13).
complexity: Table I: 62k parameters (ChannelGAN 10k); training O(E x Ntrain x U), inference O(T x Naug x U); 256 sampling steps (pp. 7, 8).
q1_support: p. 8: "Berlin urban macro LOS scenario using the QuaDRiGa simulator [40]". The beam-alignment experiment uses DeepMIMO (p. 13: "we use the DeepMIMO dataset [13] to ensure site-specificity").
q2_support: p. 7: "test set is collected from a donut-shaped region spanning 100 m to 200 m". Training uses the 100 m radius; the paper states this evaluates generalization under mismatched train/test distributions. It applies to the generator only.
q3_support: p. 13: "Gaussian noise and ChannelGAN fail to improve average SNR consistently as beams increase". Non-learned: Gaussian noise (p. 10) and exhaustive search, Genie DFT, DFT+EGC (p. 12). Learned: ChannelGAN [20] (p. 10), compared on NMSE (p. 11) and SNR (p. 13). One-shot U-net and no-DFT cDDIM are variants and are not counted.
q4_support: p. 7: "Table I compares both the parameter count and time complexity of our cDDIM-based approach". Table I lists 62k parameters and inference cost O(T x Naug x U).
q5_support: p. 13: "we use the DeepMIMO dataset [13] to ensure site-specificity". The beam-alignment experiment trains and tests on public DeepMIMO channels; the paper gives no link to its own code or data.
notes: Area 2 because the learned method is a channel generator (synthesis, p. 3) whose first downstream task is CSI compression; beam alignment (area 3) is the second downstream task. q2 rests on the Exp OOD of the generator only (100-200 m donut of the same QuaDRiGa scenario, p. 7); CRNet and the beam-alignment engine are tested on separate test sets of the same simulators. q5 rests on DeepMIMO for beam alignment (p. 13); no code or data link found. Tables I to III were read from the page images.
